description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:443: DeviationAction is a public enum without #[non_exhaustive]. The design doc implies future actions (e.g., RaiseToError, AddComment) are plausible. Without #[non_exhaustive], adding a variant is semver-breaking. Consistency with the existing #[non_exhaustive] pattern used on LintResult, Severity, Scope, SubjectKind, Error, and DeviationAddError dictates this enum should also be marked non_exhaustive.
title: DeviationAction missing #[non_exhaustive]
